answer: We formulate a dynamic opportunity-cost bond mechanism where staking collateral grows as a function of network velocity, creating a refractive prism through which identity multiplication incurs prohibitive capital costs. By embedding subgame-perfect punishment matrices within the protocol, we ensure that Sybil agents enter a downward economic spiral where slashable penalties strictly exceed the expected gains of node proliferation. Each mesa of the validator set converges to a unique Nash equilibrium where zero-knowledge verifiable delay proves the non-viability of adversarial expansion.
